# ===================================================================== # Cyclic inventory (gn_inventory_planner): request counts per location. # For every location of a planner: assign the counts of the internal quants # of its inventory groups to a user (stock.request.count) and create one # x_inventory_history to follow the progress. # ===================================================================== LOCAL_TZ = 'Europe/Madrid' # calendar day that decides what is due DAYS_PER_WEEK = 7 ONE_OFF_FREQUENCY = 0 # frequency 0 = one-off count ONE_OFF_GRACE_DAYS = 1 # a one-off still fires the night after, never later STATE_PENDING = 'pending' ACTIVE_HISTORY_STATES = ['pending', 'in_progress', 'done'] INTERNAL_USAGE = 'internal'
MANUAL = bool(env.context.get('gn_manual')) History = env['x_inventory_history'] Planner = env['x_inventory_planner'] StockQuant = env['stock.quant'] StockRequestCount = env['stock.request.count'] Users = env['res.users']
now_utc = datetime.datetime.utcnow() # datetime fields are naive UTC today = datetime.datetime.now(timezone(LOCAL_TZ)).date() # local calendar day
def quants_of(location, tags): # Every internal quant of the inventory groups: no cap (a silent cap made totals wrong) return StockQuant.search([ ('location_id', 'child_of', location.id), ('location_id.usage', '=', INTERNAL_USAGE), ('product_id.product_tmpl_id.x_studio_inventory_group_tag', 'in', tags.ids), ])
def user_for(planner, location): if planner.x_studio_user_asignado: return planner.x_studio_user_asignado return Users.search([('x_studio_assigned_warehouse', '=', location.id)], limit=1)
def already_requested(location): return History.search_count([ ('x_studio_stock_location', '=', location.id), ('x_studio_request_date', '=', today), ('x_studio_state_1', 'in', ACTIVE_HISTORY_STATES), ])
def request(planner, location, tags, user, quants, count_date): StockRequestCount.create({ 'quant_ids': [Command.set(quants.ids)], 'user_id': user.id, 'inventory_date': count_date, }).action_request_count() company = planner.x_studio_company[:1] or location.company_id or env.company History.create({ 'x_name': 'INV | %s | %s' % (location.display_name, count_date), 'x_studio_request_date': today, 'x_studio_stock_location': location.id, 'x_studio_assigned_user': user.id, 'x_studio_state_1': STATE_PENDING, 'x_studio_planner_origen': planner.id, 'x_studio_product_tag': [Command.set(tags.ids)], 'x_studio_total_products': len(quants.product_id), 'x_studio_company': company.id, })
# ===================================================================== # Manual: the selected planners, now. Every problem is shown at once and # nothing is requested if there is any (no half-done assignments). # ===================================================================== if MANUAL: if not records: raise UserError('Selecciona al menos un planificador.') problems = [] todo = [] for planner in records: locations = planner.x_studio_almacen_planner tags = planner.x_studio_etiquetas if not locations or not tags: problems.append('%s: falta el almacén o los grupos de inventario.' % planner.display_name) continue count_date = planner.x_studio_date_planner or today if count_date < today: count_date = today for location in locations: if already_requested(location): continue user = user_for(planner, location) if not user: problems.append('%s: nadie tiene asignado el almacén %s (ni hay persona en «Assigned to»).' % (planner.display_name, location.display_name)) continue quants = quants_of(location, tags) if quants: todo.append((planner, location, tags, user, quants, count_date)) if problems: raise UserError('No se ha pedido ningún recuento:\n\n' + '\n'.join(problems)) for planner, location, tags, user, quants, count_date in todo: request(planner, location, tags, user, quants, count_date) if not todo: log('Inventory planner (manual): nothing to request, already requested today or no stock', level='info')
# ===================================================================== # Cron: every planner that is due today or overdue (a failed night must # not freeze a planner forever), then its next dates. # ===================================================================== else: for planner in Planner.search([('x_studio_date_planner', '<=', today)]): inventory_date = planner.x_studio_date_planner frequency_days = int(planner.x_studio_frecuencia or 0) if frequency_days < ONE_OFF_FREQUENCY: log('Inventory planner %s: invalid frequency %r, skipped' % (planner.display_name, planner.x_studio_frecuencia), level='warning') continue
# One-off: once per date; an old one is not caught up (old trainings would all fire at once) is_one_off = frequency_days == ONE_OFF_FREQUENCY if is_one_off: last_request = planner.x_studio_last_recount_request if last_request and last_request >= inventory_date: continue if inventory_date < today - datetime.timedelta(days=ONE_OFF_GRACE_DAYS): continue
locations = planner.x_studio_almacen_planner tags = planner.x_studio_etiquetas if not locations or not tags: log('Inventory planner %s: no locations or tags, skipped' % planner.display_name, level='warning') continue
for location in locations: if already_requested(location): continue quants = quants_of(location, tags) if not quants: continue user = user_for(planner, location) if not user: log('Inventory planner %s: no user for %s, location skipped' % (planner.display_name, location.display_name), level='warning') continue request(planner, location, tags, user, quants, today)
if is_one_off: # Keep its date: last_recount_request >= date is what marks it as done planner.write({ 'x_studio_last_recount_request_time': now_utc, 'x_studio_last_recount_request': today, 'x_studio_next_recount_date': False, }) continue
next_date = today + datetime.timedelta(days=frequency_days) following_date = next_date + datetime.timedelta(days=frequency_days) if planner.x_studio_weekday: target_weekday = int(planner.x_studio_weekday) - 1 # selection 1-7 -> Python 0-6 next_date += datetime.timedelta(days=(target_weekday - next_date.weekday()) % DAYS_PER_WEEK) following_date = next_date + datetime.timedelta(days=frequency_days) following_date += datetime.timedelta(days=(target_weekday - following_date.weekday()) % DAYS_PER_WEEK)
planner.write({ 'x_studio_last_recount_request_time': now_utc, 'x_studio_last_recount_request': today, 'x_studio_date_planner': next_date, 'x_studio_next_recount_date': following_date, })

# Request the counts of the selected planners now (their dates do not move) env.ref('gn_inventory_planner.action_request_counts').with_context( gn_manual=True, active_model='x_inventory_planner', active_ids=records.ids).run()

# ===================================================================== # Cancel the selected planners: their open counts become "Cancelled", the # quants they assigned are released and the planner is ARCHIVED, so it is # never executed again. Only the quants assigned to the person of each # history are released (other counts in the same store are left alone). # To use it again: unarchive it and set the next inventory date. # ===================================================================== OPEN_STATES = ['pending', 'in_progress'] INTERNAL_USAGE = 'internal' History = env['x_inventory_history'] StockQuant = env['stock.quant']
now_utc = datetime.datetime.utcnow() now_local = datetime.datetime.now(timezone(env.user.tz or 'Europe/Madrid')) stamp = now_local.strftime('%H:%M %d/%m/%Y')
def release(history): location = history.x_studio_stock_location tags = history.x_studio_product_tag if not location or not tags: return domain = [ ('location_id', 'child_of', location.id), ('location_id.usage', '=', INTERNAL_USAGE), ('product_id.product_tmpl_id.x_studio_inventory_group_tag', 'in', tags.ids), ('user_id', '!=', False), ] if history.x_studio_assigned_user: domain.append(('user_id', '=', history.x_studio_assigned_user.id)) StockQuant.search(domain).write({'user_id': False})
for planner in records: histories = History.search([ ('x_studio_planner_origen', '=', planner.id), ('x_studio_state_1', 'in', OPEN_STATES), ]) for history in histories: release(history) if histories: histories.write({'x_studio_state_1': 'cancelled', 'x_studio_finish_date_time': now_utc}) # Chatter note always in English (team convention) planner.message_post( body='Inventory planner cancelled and archived, this scheduler will not be executed again ' '(%s open count(s) cancelled), %s %s' % (len(histories), stamp, env.user.name), subtype_xmlid='mail.mt_note') planner.write({'x_active': False})

# Cancel the selected open counts and release the quants assigned to their person OPEN_STATES = ['pending', 'in_progress'] INTERNAL_USAGE = 'internal' StockQuant = env['stock.quant'] now_utc = datetime.datetime.utcnow()
for history in records.filtered_domain([('x_studio_state_1', 'in', OPEN_STATES)]): location = history.x_studio_stock_location tags = history.x_studio_product_tag if location and tags: domain = [ ('location_id', 'child_of', location.id), ('location_id.usage', '=', INTERNAL_USAGE), ('product_id.product_tmpl_id.x_studio_inventory_group_tag', 'in', tags.ids), ('user_id', '!=', False), ] if history.x_studio_assigned_user: domain.append(('user_id', '=', history.x_studio_assigned_user.id)) StockQuant.search(domain).write({'user_id': False}) # Cancel always, even without location or groups history.write({'x_studio_state_1': 'cancelled', 'x_studio_finish_date_time': now_utc})

# ===================================================================== # Inventory History maintenance (every 15 min). # 1) Recalculate the progress of open histories. # 2) Delete closed histories older than 3 months. # ===================================================================== LOCAL_TZ = 'Europe/Madrid' STATE_PENDING = 'pending' STATE_IN_PROGRESS = 'in_progress' STATE_DONE = 'done' OPEN_STATES = [STATE_PENDING, STATE_IN_PROGRESS] PRODUCT_TYPE_STORABLE = 'product' INTERNAL_USAGE = 'internal'
RETENTION_MONTHS = 3 # closed histories older than this are deleted PURGE_BATCH = 500 # max deletions per run: keeps each run short PURGE_SAVEPOINT = 'history_purge'
History = env['x_inventory_history'].sudo() StockQuant = env['stock.quant'].sudo() Product = env['product.product'].sudo()
now_utc = datetime.datetime.utcnow() today = datetime.datetime.now(timezone(LOCAL_TZ)).date() products_cache = {}
# 1) RECALCULATE OPEN HISTORIES for history in History.search([('x_studio_state_1', 'in', OPEN_STATES)]): location = history.x_studio_stock_location tags = history.x_studio_product_tag if not location or not tags: continue
# Storable products of the inventory groups, scoped to the location's company company_id = location.company_id.id cache_key = (tuple(sorted(tags.ids)), company_id) product_ids = products_cache.get(cache_key) if product_ids is None: product_ids = Product.search([ ('product_tmpl_id.x_studio_inventory_group_tag', 'in', tags.ids), ('type', '=', PRODUCT_TYPE_STORABLE), ('company_id', 'in', [False, company_id]), ]).ids products_cache[cache_key] = product_ids if not product_ids: continue
# Total: stored when the count was requested; fallback to the group size total_products = history.x_studio_total_products or len(product_ids)
# Pending: distinct products still assigned to a counter assigned_groups = StockQuant.read_group( [ ('location_id', 'child_of', location.id), ('location_id.usage', '=', INTERNAL_USAGE), ('product_id', 'in', product_ids), ('user_id', '!=', False), ], ['product_id'], ['product_id'], ) pending_products = min(len(assigned_groups), total_products)
if pending_products == 0: new_state = STATE_DONE elif pending_products == total_products: new_state = STATE_PENDING else: new_state = STATE_IN_PROGRESS
# Write only what changed (no useless writes, no tracking noise) vals = {} if history.x_studio_total_products != total_products: vals['x_studio_total_products'] = total_products if history.x_studio_missing_products != pending_products: vals['x_studio_missing_products'] = pending_products if history.x_studio_state_1 != new_state: vals['x_studio_state_1'] = new_state if new_state == STATE_DONE and not history.x_studio_finish_date_time: vals['x_studio_finish_date_time'] = now_utc if new_state != STATE_DONE and history.x_studio_finish_date_time: vals['x_studio_finish_date_time'] = False if vals: history.write(vals)
# 2) PURGE CLOSED HISTORIES OLDER THAN RETENTION_MONTHS # Open ones are kept: they still drive step 1 and their quants are assigned. cutoff = today - dateutil.relativedelta.relativedelta(months=RETENTION_MONTHS) expired = History.with_context(active_test=False).search([ ('x_studio_request_date', '<', cutoff), ('x_studio_state_1', 'not in', OPEN_STATES), ], limit=PURGE_BATCH)
if expired: # Savepoint: a failed purge must not undo the recalculation above env.cr.execute('SAVEPOINT ' + PURGE_SAVEPOINT) try: expired_count = len(expired) expired.unlink() env.flush_all() env.cr.execute('RELEASE SAVEPOINT ' + PURGE_SAVEPOINT) log('Inventory History purge: %s deleted (request date before %s)' % (expired_count, cutoff), level='info') except Exception as error: env.cr.execute('ROLLBACK TO SAVEPOINT ' + PURGE_SAVEPOINT) env.invalidate_all() log('Inventory History purge failed: %s' % error, level='error')
